entities.summary: Georgian Mamluk, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with Ottoman Iraq (1704–1831). Preceded by Mamluk Governors of Baghdad and Suleiman the Magnificent. Their legacy influenced Tanzimat Reforms in Iraq.
